source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U04: Apply disclosure,prudent care,authorised use and mixing consequences

payload.title: The care standard does not depend on a careless custodian habits
payload.core_explanation_md:
A bailee must apply the statutory prudent-person care standard for comparable goods;the phrase own goods should not be used to excuse a person who routinely neglects their own property. The source also separates fault disclosure by the bailor,including the stated hired-goods rule,from the bailee care and authorised-use duties.

Mixing goods has different consequences depending on consent and separability. Consented mixing preserves the stated proportional interests;unconsented separable mixing brings separation-cost and damage consequences;inseparable mixing raises compensation. Do not infer that all mixtures transfer ownership to the person who did the mixing.

self_check.prompt_text: Can a bailee lower the legal standard by proving personal carelessness with their own goods?
self_check.expected_takeaway: No. Apply the statutory prudent-care standard.

payload.stem_md: A custodian defends neglect by saying its own goods are equally neglected. Which standard matters?

options.explanation_md: Personal neglect cannot define the statutory standard.

options.text_md: Whether a loss happened determines fault automatically
options.explanation_md: The circumstances and care need examination.

options.text_md: Prudent care for comparable goods under the applicable rule
options.explanation_md: The standard is not whatever this custodian happens to do.

payload.correct_explanation_md: The standard is not whatever this custodian happens to do.

payload.stem_md: Without consent,a bailee mixes identifiable goods that remain separable. What should the file distinguish?

options.text_md: All property automatically becomes the bailee own
options.explanation_md: Mixing does not give that result.

options.text_md: Continuing ownership and the separation-cost/damage consequences
options.explanation_md: The source distinguishes separable from inseparable mixtures.

options.text_md: The bailor must waive every claim
options.explanation_md: No waiver follows merely from mixing.

options.text_md: The goods are legally destroyed even though identifiable

payload.correct_explanation_md: The source distinguishes separable from inseparable mixtures.
